blocks.text: Gatun Lake, Monkey Island and San Lorenzo Fortress

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: Verified Word paragraphs 25–27 describe the lake and fortress but do not name Monkey Island in a corresponding combined heading.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, set off on a boat tour through the Panama Canal system.

The route crosses Gatun Lake.

Monkey Island is one of the main natural attractions.

During the boat trip, you may see capuchins, howler monkeys and small tamarins.

Toucans and herons can also be seen.

This day combines nature with engineering infrastructure: large cargo ships using the canal pass close to the islands and jungle.

In the afternoon, visit San Lorenzo Fortress.

It stands on the Chagres River within the national park.

The fortifications offer views of the tropical forest, river and Caribbean Sea.

Monkeys and toucans may be seen in the surrounding forest.

An English-speaking guide accompanies you for the day if this service has been confirmed on request.
